★
Achievement unlockedDeck Master

Your decks are one tap away. On a phone or a tablet, tapping a deck in Decks & Collection opens everything you can do with it. The deck builder shows your hero's card, Deck check lists every separate deck a hero brings, and the Mod Store updates all your packs with one button. Take your seats and Deck check read in Spanish, and a long list of your reports is fixed, from ally stat badges to Take a Stand.

Your decks, one tap away

Issues #920, #958, #960 · PRs #925, #959, #965
★
Achievement unlockedSpider-Man Suits Up

The deck builder shows the hero you're building for. The chosen hero sits under the title as one row, with its picture and name. Tap it to open the identity in Inspect, which flips between hero and alter-ego. On a desktop, the picture opens the card hover. Suggested by @PermaKarma.

★
Achievement unlockedCaptain Marvel Takes Charge

On a phone or a tablet, tapping a deck in Decks & Collection opens its options. Before, a tap only selected the deck, and its actions sat on another tab. Asked for by Carl (The Lone Adventurer) on Discord.

Everything a deck can do

  • Play this deck opens Scenario select first, then Take your seats with the deck already in seat one. It's off, with the reason, when the deck isn't legal.
  • Edit opens the deck in the deck builder (Edit a copy for a precon).
  • View cards and Stats jump to those tabs.
  • Check, Duplicate and Delete for your own decks. Delete takes a second press and says it can't be undone.
  • A community deck offers Add to my decks, View cards and Check.
  • The end of a swipe never presses a button by mistake.
★
Achievement unlockedDoctor Strange Shows His Hand

Deck check shows everything a hero brings besides the deck. Each separate deck (Doctor Strange's Invocation deck, Hercules' Gift and Labor decks, Storm's Weather and more), the obligation and the nemesis set each get their own group, outside the deck count. Reported by @bluefireF5ran.

Custom heroes and campaigns. The campaign seat picker now says "Custom heroes and decks with custom cards can't join a campaign yet." instead of looking like the hero is missing.

Mod Store packs, smoother

Issues #922, #943, #951, #957 · PRs #949, #950, #953, #961
★
Achievement unlockedQuicksilver Runs the Updates

Update all. When installed packs have updates, the Mod Store has an Update all button that updates every one of them, one after another, with one progress bar and a Stop button. If a pack can't update, it keeps its old version and a line names it. Asked for by Firedudeman750 on Discord.

Packs play better

  • A Mod Store pack's modular set shows its cards on Set the table, instead of its id and 0 cards. Reported by @PermaKarma.
  • A pack scenario that sets a modular set aside has a Set-aside modular set stepper on Set the table. It starts on the set the pack's authors recommend instead of a random one. Reported by @bluefireF5ran.
  • A pack that answers a card discarded from a hand, like "Don't Make Me Angry!", is no longer refused as needing an app update. Reported by @bluefireF5ran.
  • If a pack's bad data stops the game from drawing a decision, you get plain answer buttons instead of a stuck game.

For pack makers: mc-pack validate now type-checks a pack's abilities with TypeScript and fails on a type error, so a slip like gainsKeyword("guard", …) no longer passes validation and then crashes a game. Pass --skip-typecheck to leave it out. Scenarios can name their recommendedSetAsideModularSetIds.

From the play notes

Issue #966 · PR #969
★
Achievement unlockedSpider-Punisher Takes Aim

@bluefireF5ran wrote up another run of play notes. Your stats now shows their pictures, and Enhanced Combat Sense pays the way you'd expect.

  • Your stats draws Mod Store heroes and villains with their pack pictures on the Overview and Matchups. SP//dr Suit's row shows its hero side.
  • Enhanced Combat Sense shows one tile per Weapon or Tech upgrade, with that upgrade's card, instead of one tile per combination.
  • Dynamic Duo can be played with nothing to find. When paying with a Team-Up card in your hand is what puts it in the discard pile, the pay bar says so.
  • Decks & Collection shows each deck's aspect chips. On a desktop, a click on a deck opens its Check, and Back returns with the deck still picked.
  • Choose a scenario: a Mod Store scenario sits under the chip of its shelf, so installing packs no longer adds a chip each.

Take your seats, Deck check and the name-conflict sheet now read in Spanish. Switch the language and they follow. Card, hero and set names stay in English for now. Written by @bluefireF5ran.

You asked, we fixed

Issues #935, #937, #943, #962, #967, #970 · PRs #944, #950, #964, #968, #971
★
Achievement unlockedJubilee Reads the Fine Print

Ally badges stay off the small print

An ally's THW and ATK badges sit on the printed stats at every card size, so the consequential damage printed under them stays visible.

Issue #935 from @neopolii · PR #944

Matchups names custom content

Your stats, Matchups names custom scenarios and encounter sets instead of showing their ids, and tags them with their designer, such as The Rose (by PermaKarma).

Issue #937 from @PermaKarma · PR #944

Take a Stand waits for your turn

Take a Stand and other cards whose whole effect lasts to the end of the player phase or turn are no longer offered outside it, so they aren't played for nothing after a defense in the villain phase.

Issue #970 from @FirePenguin17 · PR #971

Hired Gun after the flip

Once Criminal Enterprise has flipped to State of Madness, Hired Gun no longer offers to place infamy counters on it. The villain takes the boost card, and the log says why.

Issue #967 from @FirePenguin17 · PR #968

Thomas Edison, pinned down

New two-player tests show that he can't take damage from any player while the player he's engaged with has another minion engaged, per the FFG ruling.

Issue #962 from @FirePenguin17 · PR #964

Pick from the cards tucked under

Tapping the UNDER strip of a card with several cards tucked under it, while paying, opens them to choose from instead of spending the first one.

Issue #943 from @bluefireF5ran · PR #950
